canonical_project: AirTrunk SYD2 / Lane Cove West Data Centre, 1 Sirius Road
notes: NSW Planning records SSD-9741 as approved/determined for 24-hour operation of a four-storey data centre at 1 Sirius Road and 2 Apollo Place, Lane Cove West. Contractor pages identify the facility as AirTrunk's Lane Cove West site and report expansion taking total capacity above 120 MW.
